**Jerry**(**JP**: ジェリー _Jerī_) is a [monster](https://undertale.wiki/w/Monster "Monster") that [the protagonist](https://undertale.wiki/w/Frisk "Frisk") encounters in [Snowdin](https://undertale.wiki/w/Snowdin "Snowdin"). Jerry is unique in that it has no attack of its own, but instead causes other monsters' attacks to last two seconds longer than normal.

## Profile

[](http://undertale.wiki/e/Jerry?section=1 "Edit section: Profile")

### Appearance

[](http://undertale.wiki/e/Jerry?section=2 "Edit section: Appearance")

Jerry appears to be a monster shaped like a flying saucer. It has three dull, thick spikes on the top of its head, some black spots, very long narrow arms, four legs, two rectangular eyes on the widest portion of their body, and swollen lips.

### Personality

[](http://undertale.wiki/e/Jerry?section=3 "Edit section: Personality")

Jerry's traits are similar to the stereotype "[That Guy.](https://urbandictionary.com/define.php?term=That+Guy)" Examples include profuse arrogance, disrespect, informal language, poor hygiene (licking its hands and sneezing without wiping), and ungratefulness. These traits generally cause Jerry to not be a satisfiable person in general, which explains why only the "Ditch" option is present. However, if the protagonist tells a joke in a battle where Snowdrake is present, it finds it funny and may even ask for more jokes from them, having equally positive reactions from more of their jokes. This satisfies it to the point of being spareable.

Jerry's in-game function is that of a support member (e.g. Bard, Dancer), whose role is to bolster the offensive capabilities of other monsters. While support members are usually considered welcome additions to the party in most RPGs, other monsters are shown to dislike Jerry's presence. Jerry itself also dislikes other monsters, despite supporting them.[[2]](http://undertale.wiki/wiki/Jerry#cite_note-2)[[3]](http://undertale.wiki/wiki/Jerry#cite_note-3)

## Main story

[](http://undertale.wiki/e/Jerry?section=4 "Edit section: Main story")

### Strategy

[](http://undertale.wiki/e/Jerry?section=7 "Edit section: Strategy")

*   Ditching Jerry causes it to disappear, but it returns after two or three turns. Sparing all other monsters while Jerry is ditched ends the fight.
*   Jerry can immediately be spared if the protagonist has high enough AT.
*   When Jerry appears with Snowdrake or Chilldrake and the protagonist makes a joke, Jerry can be spared.
*   Due to its high defense, Jerry is surprisingly hard to kill, and takes around nine hits to kill with weapons obtainable before or in Snowdin. This is because of a special rule at the end of its damage calculation that divides all damage dealt to Jerry by 5, giving it an effective HP of 400.

## Creation and development

[](http://undertale.wiki/e/Jerry?section=10 "Edit section: Creation and development")

[![Image 5: Jerry artwork concept.png](http://undertale.wiki/images/thumb/Jerry_artwork_concept.png/300px-Jerry_artwork_concept.png.webp?cb=elh15c&h=thumb.php&f=Jerry_artwork_concept.png)](https://undertale.wiki/w/File:Jerry_artwork_concept.png)

Magnolia Porter's concept art of Jerry

Jerry was designed by [Magnolia Porter](https://undertale.wiki/w/Magnolia_Porter "Magnolia Porter"), creator of [_Monster Pulse_.](https://www.monster-pulse.com/) She also designed [Monster Kid](https://undertale.wiki/w/Monster_Kid "Monster Kid"), Snowdrake, Ice Cap, and helped design [Gyftrot](https://undertale.wiki/w/Gyftrot "Gyftrot").

During the [_UNDERTALE_ 10th Anniversary Stream](https://undertale.wiki/w/UNDERTALE_10th_Anniversary_Stream "UNDERTALE 10th Anniversary Stream"), [Toby Fox](https://undertale.wiki/w/Toby_Fox "Toby Fox") stated that Jerry is also based off a joke that he made in high school about a fictional annoying character named Jerry.[[4]](http://undertale.wiki/wiki/Jerry#cite_note-4)

## Outside of _Undertale_

[](http://undertale.wiki/e/Jerry?section=11 "Edit section: Outside of Undertale")

Main article: [Terry](https://deltarune.wiki/w/Terry "dr:Terry")

In [Chapter 2](https://deltarune.wiki/w/Chapter%202 "dr:Chapter 2") of _[Deltarune](https://deltarune.wiki/w/Deltarune "dr:Deltarune")_, Terry is shown hanging out with a group of [Ice Caps](https://deltarune.wiki/w/Ice%20Cap "dr:Ice Cap") near the [church](https://deltarune.wiki/w/Church "dr:Church").

In [Chapter 5](https://deltarune.wiki/w/Chapter%205 "dr:Chapter 5"), Terry appears in the crowd during [Pizzapants](https://deltarune.wiki/w/Pizzapants "dr:Pizzapants")'s performance in front of [Noelle's House](https://deltarune.wiki/w/Noelle's%20House "dr:Noelle's House").

## Allusions

[](http://undertale.wiki/e/Jerry?section=12 "Edit section: Allusions")

*   The line "_Return of Jerry_" when Jerry reappears during a battle is a reference to the 1988 game _[Zelda II: The Adventure of Link](https://zeldawiki.wiki/wiki/Zelda%20II:%20The%20Adventure%20of%20Link "zeldawiki:Zelda II: The Adventure of Link")_, which includes the text "_RETURN OF GANON_" on the game over screen, even when the game's language was in Japanese (spelled as "GANNON" instead). Because of this, the sentence was intentionally left untranslated in the Japanese translation to keep the reference.[[5]](http://undertale.wiki/wiki/Jerry#cite_note-5)

## Trivia

[](http://undertale.wiki/e/Jerry?section=14 "Edit section: Trivia")

*   When attempting to name the [fallen human](https://undertale.wiki/w/Chara "Chara") "Jerry", the response is "_Jerry._" and the name is allowed to be used.
*   In the original release, the dialogue Jerry used when returning from being ditched was identical to Ice Caps when using Compliment. This was removed in a later patch.
*   [Toby Fox](https://undertale.wiki/w/Toby_Fox "Toby Fox") has said on Twitter that he thinks all monsters in the game are good, except Jerry.[[6]](http://undertale.wiki/wiki/Jerry#cite_note-6)
    *   Although this tweet is likely meant to be interpreted as a joke, he may also be referring to Jerry's personality and mannerisms being negative and nearly irredeemable.

Jerry

**Jerry**(**JP**: ジェリー _Jerī_) is a [monster](https://undertale.wiki/w/Monster "Monster") that [the protagonist](https://undertale.wiki/w/Frisk "Frisk") encounters in [Snowdin](https://undertale.wiki/w/Snowdin "Snowdin"). Jerry is unique in that it has no attack of its own, but instead causes other monsters' attacks to last two seconds longer than normal.

## Profile

[](http://undertale.wiki/e/Jerry?section=1 "Edit section: Profile")

### Appearance

[](http://undertale.wiki/e/Jerry?section=2 "Edit section: Appearance")

Jerry appears to be a monster shaped like a flying saucer. It has three dull, thick spikes on the top of its head, some black spots, very long narrow arms, four legs, two rectangular eyes on the widest portion of their body, and swollen lips.

### Personality

[](http://undertale.wiki/e/Jerry?section=3 "Edit section: Personality")

Jerry's traits are similar to the stereotype "[That Guy.](https://urbandictionary.com/define.php?term=That+Guy)" Examples include profuse arrogance, disrespect, informal language, poor hygiene (licking its hands and sneezing without wiping), and ungratefulness. These traits generally cause Jerry to not be a satisfiable person in general, which explains why only the "Ditch" option is present. However, if the protagonist tells a joke in a battle where Snowdrake is present, it finds it funny and may even ask for more jokes from them, having equally positive reactions from more of their jokes. This satisfies it to the point of being spareable.

Jerry's in-game function is that of a support member (e.g. Bard, Dancer), whose role is to bolster the offensive capabilities of other monsters. While support members are usually considered welcome additions to the party in most RPGs, other monsters are shown to dislike Jerry's presence. Jerry itself also dislikes other monsters, despite supporting them.[[2]](http://undertale.wiki/wiki/Jerry#cite_note-2)[[3]](http://undertale.wiki/wiki/Jerry#cite_note-3)

[](http://undertale.wiki/e/Jerry?section=4 "Edit section: Main story")

### Strategy

[](http://undertale.wiki/e/Jerry?section=7 "Edit section: Strategy")

*   Ditching Jerry causes it to disappear, but it returns after two or three turns. Sparing all other monsters while Jerry is ditched ends the fight.
*   Jerry can immediately be spared if the protagonist has high enough AT.
*   When Jerry appears with Snowdrake or Chilldrake and the protagonist makes a joke, Jerry can be spared.
*   Due to its high defense, Jerry is surprisingly hard to kill, and takes around nine hits to kill with weapons obtainable before or in Snowdin. This is because of a special rule at the end of its damage calculation that divides all damage dealt to Jerry by 5, giving it an effective HP of 400.

## Creation and development

[](http://undertale.wiki/e/Jerry?section=10 "Edit section: Creation and development")

[![Image 5: Jerry artwork concept.png](http://undertale.wiki/images/thumb/Jerry_artwork_concept.png/300px-Jerry_artwork_concept.png.webp?cb=elh15c&h=thumb.php&f=Jerry_artwork_concept.png)](https://undertale.wiki/w/File:Jerry_artwork_concept.png)

Magnolia Porter's concept art of Jerry

Jerry was designed by [Magnolia Porter](https://undertale.wiki/w/Magnolia_Porter "Magnolia Porter"), creator of [_Monster Pulse_.](https://www.monster-pulse.com/) She also designed [Monster Kid](https://undertale.wiki/w/Monster_Kid "Monster Kid"), Snowdrake, Ice Cap, and helped design [Gyftrot](https://undertale.wiki/w/Gyftrot "Gyftrot").

During the [_UNDERTALE_ 10th Anniversary Stream](https://undertale.wiki/w/UNDERTALE_10th_Anniversary_Stream "UNDERTALE 10th Anniversary Stream"), [Toby Fox](https://undertale.wiki/w/Toby_Fox "Toby Fox") stated that Jerry is also based off a joke that he made in high school about a fictional annoying character named Jerry.[[4]](http://undertale.wiki/wiki/Jerry#cite_note-4)

## Outside of _Undertale_

[](http://undertale.wiki/e/Jerry?section=11 "Edit section: Outside of Undertale")

Main article: [Terry](https://deltarune.wiki/w/Terry "dr:Terry")

In [Chapter 2](https://deltarune.wiki/w/Chapter%202 "dr:Chapter 2") of _[Deltarune](https://deltarune.wiki/w/Deltarune "dr:Deltarune")_, Terry is shown hanging out with a group of [Ice Caps](https://deltarune.wiki/w/Ice%20Cap "dr:Ice Cap") near the [church](https://deltarune.wiki/w/Church "dr:Church").

In [Chapter 5](https://deltarune.wiki/w/Chapter%205 "dr:Chapter 5"), Terry appears in the crowd during [Pizzapants](https://deltarune.wiki/w/Pizzapants "dr:Pizzapants")'s performance in front of [Noelle's House](https://deltarune.wiki/w/Noelle's%20House "dr:Noelle's House").

## Allusions

[](http://undertale.wiki/e/Jerry?section=12 "Edit section: Allusions")

*   The line "_Return of Jerry_" when Jerry reappears during a battle is a reference to the 1988 game _[Zelda II: The Adventure of Link](https://zeldawiki.wiki/wiki/Zelda%20II:%20The%20Adventure%20of%20Link "zeldawiki:Zelda II: The Adventure of Link")_, which includes the text "_RETURN OF GANON_" on the game over screen, even when the game's language was in Japanese (spelled as "GANNON" instead). Because of this, the sentence was intentionally left untranslated in the Japanese translation to keep the reference.[[5]](http://undertale.wiki/wiki/Jerry#cite_note-5)

## Trivia

[](http://undertale.wiki/e/Jerry?section=14 "Edit section: Trivia")

*   When attempting to name the [fallen human](https://undertale.wiki/w/Chara "Chara") "Jerry", the response is "_Jerry._" and the name is allowed to be used.
*   In the original release, the dialogue Jerry used when returning from being ditched was identical to Ice Caps when using Compliment. This was removed in a later patch.
*   [Toby Fox](https://undertale.wiki/w/Toby_Fox "Toby Fox") has said on Twitter that he thinks all monsters in the game are good, except Jerry.[[6]](http://undertale.wiki/wiki/Jerry#cite_note-6)
    *   Although this tweet is likely meant to be interpreted as a joke, he may also be referring to Jerry's personality and mannerisms being negative and nearly irredeemable.
